newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AUXERRE INFLICT SECOND HOME DEFEAT ON AJAX.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUXERRE INFLICT SECOND HOME DEFEAT ON AJAX.

text.p: French title-holders Auxerre beat former European champions Ajax Amsterdam 2-1 in a European Champions' League group A match on Wednesday.

The result, Ajax's second home defeat in the competition, brings Auxerre level with Ajax on points in the group and leaves the Dutch champions needing to find something special on next month's visit to Grasshopper Zurich.

Auxerre, needing to win to keep alive their hopes of reaching the quarter-finals of Europe's top club competition at the first attempt, got off to a dream start when Steve Marlet chipped in from the right, Lilian Laslandes headed on and Bernard Diomede had time and space to rifle his shot past Edwin van der Sar for his third Champions' League goal.
A minute before the break Ajax drew level with Nigerian winger Tijani Babangida scrambling home after rounding Lionel Charbonnier in the Auxerre goal.
But 11 minutes into the second half, his fellow countryman Taribo West powered through the home defence on a surging run and fed Marlet who sealed victory for the French club.
